authority.designAuthority: Principal approval of explicit operator preservation, multiple human participants, mediated human communication, continuous operation, and planned suspension fallback on 2026-08-13

operator: authenticated human principal, durable operator actor, and control surface are distinct identities
operator actor uses exact FQN, ExecutionId, fencing, qualification, work-profile, and role-bundle rules
operator name and role content grant no intrinsic authority
operator may present or summarize a human interaction but cannot impersonate its originator or respondent
humanParticipation: multiple exact HUMAN principals may independently hold the same or different scoped roles
SME, client, end-user, approver, principal, and project-defined labels select role bindings but grant no intrinsic authority
participant profiles contain versioned scoped roles and opaque authentication and delivery bindings without reusable credentials or raw contact addresses
ordinary consultation uses a finite human-interaction aggregate rather than being coerced into escalation
questions bind exact recipients, canonical and response-specification digests, purpose, effect, response policy, deadline, confidentiality, disclosure scope, and causal lineage
operator renderings retain canonical and rendered digests plus presenter and delivery provenance; material divergence requires equivalence evidence or a successor interaction
responses require exact selected active HUMAN authority, current profile and question, active authentication and delivery lineage, and null actor execution
EXACT_ONE, ANY_ONE, ALL, and QUORUM count distinct selected humans
advice, evidence, and independently authorized decision effects remain distinct
delivery, silence, manual relay, role labels, shared channels, and response text do not independently create authority or consent
one-time response capabilities remain retryable until the accepted response commit
hostContinuity: CONTINUOUS is the preferred posture only while required local services and host leases are observed healthy
planned control state is ACTIVE to QUIESCING to SUSPENDED to RECONCILING to ACTIVE
planned quiescence and unexpected outage advance a monotonic power epoch and close admission
provider execution disposition is preregistered as CANCEL_ON_SUSPEND, COMPLETE_AND_QUARANTINE, or DETACH_AND_RECONCILE
late prior-epoch results remain evidence and cannot create organizational truth
resume requires exact reconciliation and an authorized HUMAN or POLICY command

knownLimitations: No 0.7.0 Go implementation has been authorized or performed.
No operator role bundle has been implemented, signed, or activated.
No participant directory, authentication provider, channel adapter, response portal, credential, endpoint, or confidentiality control has been implemented or qualified.
Questions, renderings, responses, endpoints, and credential subjects are represented by opaque digests; secure artifact storage and access enforcement remain implementation responsibilities.
No host sleep/wake, closed-display, dedicated-host, remote-job, or provider-cancellation behavior has been empirically qualified.
No OpenHands, SMA, model-provider, production, migration, or deployment authority is created by this candidate.
Repository regression tests exercise the current accepted implementation and do not prove the additive 0.7.0 runtime semantics.
